steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids in Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the case.
Allocate all requested units to Vendor B and create and submit the award proposal.
Confirm that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal as the buyer approver.
Verify that the approved proposal overview shows the Letter of Award.
Verify that the proposal overview shows the Letter of Award Status for the awarded vendor.
